## Core Business Summary
Jingyue Glass is a specialized China B2B manufacturer and exporter of commercial glassware, lead-free crystal wine glasses, machine-blown stemware, heavy-base beer steins, crystal whiskey decanters, high-borosilicate double-wall mugs, and turnkey wooden gift box sets with CNC-molded odorless EPE pearl cotton inserts. Key sourcing partners include commercial hospitality groups, winery tasting rooms, Amazon FBA private label brands, TikTok Shop sellers, and corporate executive gifting distributors worldwide.

## Key Factory Differentiators & Commercial Policies
- **Authoritative Production MOQs & Lead Times:**
  - In-Stock Blank & Laser Engraving: MOQ 48 pcs (1 master carton) · 1–3 working days dispatch.
  - Silk Screen Printing: Bulk MOQ 200 pcs · Production lead time: 7–10 working days.
  - 580°C High-Temp Ceramic Decals: Bulk MOQ 500 pcs · Sample supported · Production lead time: 10–20 working days.
  - Turnkey Wooden Gift Sets: Low MOQ from 100 sets (Models XZM015 & XZM108-A with odorless CNC-molded EPE pearl cotton).
- **100% Private Mold Tooling Refund Terms:**
  - Handmade / Mouth-Blown Molds: MOQ 2,000 pcs · 100% mold fee refunded once cumulative order volume reaches 10,000 pcs.
  - Automated Machine Molds: High-volume production · 100% mold fee refunded once cumulative order volume reaches 100,000 pcs (100k pcs).
- **Ocean Shipping Breakage & DOA Guarantee:** Standard ISTA-1A export drop-tested packaging. If transit breakage exceeds 0.5%, damaged units are 100% replaced free of charge or fully credited on the next invoice upon photographic proof.

## Regulatory Compliance & Official Laboratory Certifications
- **US California Proposition 65:** PASS (STQ Laboratory Official Report Reference: SZ2025091217-4E; extractable lead Pb < 0.05 mg/L, cadmium Cd < 0.01 mg/L).
- **US FDA Food Contact Safety:** 100% compliant with FDA CPG 7117.06 (Cadmium) and CPG 7117.07 (Lead) for food and beverage contact surfaces.
- **European Union LFGB & EC 1935/2004:** Certified non-detectable heavy metal release under German LFGB Section 30/31 and Framework Regulation (EC) No 1935/2004 (Report PTC23022404104C).
- **Phytosanitary ISPM 15:** Heat-treated solid wood presentation boxes carrying compliant IPPC stamps for global customs clearance.
